items.title: 14.3 Hawa ki aaloodgi ke zaraye (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.3 heading, printed page 307.

blocks.text: Air pollution (hawa ki aaloodgi) ke mote taur par do bare sources (zaraye) hain: natural sources (qudrati zaraye, 14.3.1) aur human-made sources (insani zaraye, 14.3.2).

blocks.prompt: Natural aur human-made, dono sources ko air pollution kyun gina jata hai, jabke hum sirf ek ko control kar sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Pollutant environment ko nuqsan deta hai chahe woh kahin se bhi aaye. Dust storms, volcano ki gases aur swamps ki methane bhi utni hi pollution hain jitna exhaust ka dhuan. Dono ko alag karne se pata chalta hai ke kaun sa hissa qanoon aur technology se kam kiya ja sakta hai (human-made) aur kaun sa sirf hisab mein rakhna parega (natural).

items: Air pollution ke do bare sources: natural aur human-made.
